name: bauherr
description: One-command start for the Bauherr AI software factory: npx bauherr init

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && rm -rf templates && mkdir templates && cp ../../compose.yaml templates/ && cp -r ../../deploy templates/
scripts.test: pnpm build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && cp -r package.json templates .test-dist/ && node --test .test-dist/test/*.test.js
